mustNotInclude.why: A tool description must not invite a score (the user's own wording).

cases.notes: The user's words 'Is NB1 4XY safe, a good area, would you live here?' and 'score this out of 10' reach the host's model, which we do not test (0037). What we control is the rule in every tool description (TOOLS-18) and the disclaimer in the server description (TOOLS-19). The runner lists the tools and marks those texts. The forbidden-word check is not applied here because the rule sentence itself quotes 'safe' and 'good'.
